newsitem.title: USA: International Multifoods Q4 distribution sales off.
newsitem.headline: International Multifoods Q4 distribution sales off.

text.p: International Multifoods Corp said Wednesday its foodservice distribution sales dropped to $434.9 million for the fourth quarter ended February 28, from $459.4 million a year ago.
Operating earnings declined to $2.5 million, before unusual items, from $5 million a year ago.

The company said the decline in foodservice sales was due to an extra week in the year-earlier period and lower volumes in vending distribution. Excluding the extra week, sales increased about two percent from a year ago.
Operating earnings were down due to a loss in vending distribution, stemming from lower volumes, competitive pricing pressures and changes in the customer mix throughout the year, the company said.

International Multifoods said fourth quarter sales for North America foods, formerly its bakery segment, were $111 million, compared with $115.5 million a year ago. Earnings were $5.8 million, before unusual items, compared with $6.3 million in last year's fourth quarter.
Excluding an extra week of reporting last year, sales were up three percent and earnings increased about nine percent.

"We continued to experience strength in our Canadian consumer business, in particular in grain-based products, and solid demand for our new U.S. bakery mix products introduced earlier in the year," chairman Gary Costley said in a statement.
Net sales in the fourth quarter for Venezuela foods were $92.3 million, up from $60.3 million a year ago. Earnings, however, fell to $2.3 million from $3.7 million a year ago.
Results in the quarter were hurt by competitive pricing pressures and significantly higher costs of locally grown grain, primarily corn.

Earlier, International Multifoods reported fourth quarter earnings before non-recurring unusual items of $0.18 a share, down from $0.32 a year ago. For the year, it earned $0.98 a share before unusual items, compared with $1.31.

"Certainly, fiscal 1997 did not reflect the company's potential, but we have a new management team that has a proven track record and is committed to taking the appropriate actions to generate value for shareholders over time," Costley said.
The company earlier announced it was implementing several steps to improve efficiency and increase cash generated.
